Brand Introduction:
NurseMade Naturals is a holistic wellness brand dedicated to providing high-quality, natural skincare, beauty, and aromatherapy products. Inspired by the healing power of nature, we carefully craft our products using ethically sourced ingredients to nourish the body and soul. Our offerings cater to individuals seeking a balanced lifestyle through sustainable beauty and wellness solutions.
Product Description:
At NurseMade Naturals, we offer a diverse range of products designed to enhance your natural beauty and well-being. Our skincare line includes nourishing masks, refreshing shampoos, and indulgent body sprays made with pure, natural ingredients like volcanic mud, aloe vera, and essential oils. Our aromatherapy collection features hand-poured candles and incense burners that transform any space into a serene oasis. Each product is thoughtfully formulated to deliver results you can feel, without compromising on quality or sustainability.
Unique Selling Point (USP):
• Natural Ingredients: Our products are made with 100% natural, ethically sourced ingredients, free from harmful chemicals.
• Holistic Wellness: We focus on creating products that not only beautify but also promote overall well-being.
• Eco-Friendly: From our packaging to our sourcing methods, we prioritize sustainability in every aspect of our business.
• Handcrafted Quality: Every product is handcrafted with care to ensure the highest quality.
Payment Terms:
Affiliates will receive a 10% commission on every sale generated through their referral link. Payments are processed via PayPal or Venmo.

Other Information:
Affilates receive products at half price if using products for promotional material. Some affiliates will be eligible for free products to promote based on following, commission sales, and/or other influencing factors.
